Some images from an alternate scenario in which Homeless Dog is a MILF!

In this universe, she never went homeless. Instead, she got married young and has 2 kids with a husband who gambled the family's money and ran away. Out of desperation, she accepted a deal with her husband's business partner for cheap rent in exchange for certain favors...

This scenario is currently very popular with my fanbase, so I decided to create some subscriber stretch goals to fund the production of more content relating to her!
If you wanna support my comics please consider subscribing:
